page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.24xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 96 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, resulting in 96 vCPUs. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high resource density of the ecs.g8i.24xlarge make it suitable for enterprise workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading.

Due to its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and high network throughput, the ecs.g8i.24xlarge is designed for multi-threaded applications, enterprise web serving, application servers, and medium-sized database deployments that require consistent processing power and high network capacity.
